doc.title: Advisor Call — Tanya Team, Tina Team, Xavier Expert, Freya Free — 2026-07-28

footing_cases.author: Tanya TeamOwner
footing_cases.when: Editorial context / narrative setting introducing the advisor call transcript

segments.exact: Tanya Team has pulled three of her advisors onto one call before she starts fundraising, to settle who aswritten sells to first and what keeps them. Tina Team works sales and go-to-market with her; Xavier Expert is an operator who consults for mid-market businesses; Freya Free is a designer who has worked with her on the brand. Each has given Tanya a view on this separately; this is the first time the four of them are on one call.
